name: releasevantra
description: Base local del SaaS multiempresa ReleaseVantra — Fase A1

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @releasevantra/shared" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/shared && npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/api && npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @releasevantra/shared && npm run test --workspace @releasevantra/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
